decks.notes: This deck focuses on using efficient creatures and disruptive spells to apply early pressure on the opponent while also disrupting their game plan. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Snuff Out to disrupt the opponent's hand and creatures like Wight of the Reliquary and Scythecat Cub to apply pressure on the board, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Once Upon a Time to ensure consistency in finding the right threats at the right time. With a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, this deck aims to be a versatile and powerful force in the Legacy format.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of disruption, removal, and card advantage. It utilizes cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to shut down opponent's plays, while also running efficient removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Swords to Plowshares. It has a mix of creatures like Murktide Regent and Barrowgoyf to pressure opponents while maintaining control. The mana base is optimized for consistency and flexibility, with access to various colors for spell versatility. The goal is to outvalue opponents and dictate the pace of the game to secure a win.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor combo to mill the library, putting Narcomoebas onto the battlefield. Thassa's Oracle or Dread Return then allows for a game-winning finish. The deck runs disruption in Force of Will, Daze, and Swords to Plowshares while also using cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder for consistency. Urza's Saga serves as a versatile toolbox, and Prismatic Ending helps with removal. The deck aims to be fast and resilient, with various lines of play to achieve victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently get creatures into the graveyard and then bring them back to the battlefield using reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck includes powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Archon of Cruelty that can swing the game in your favor once they hit the battlefield. The deck also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect your combo pieces and disrupt your opponent's game plan. Overall, the key strategy is to cheat big creatures into play early and overwhelm your opponent.

The deck focuses on using Cascade spells like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to quickly overwhelm opponents with strong creatures like Murktide Regent and Crashing Footfalls. It also utilizes cards like Hullbreacher and Lórien Revealed to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck includes a mix of counter spells like Force of Will and Force of Negation for protection. The mana base includes fetch lands and dual lands for consistency. Overall, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining a strong board presence.

The main concept of this deck is to create a combo using Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill through the opponent's deck and win the game. The deck utilizes cards like Goblin Engineer and Goblin Welder to tutor for and recur key pieces, while also including disruptive elements like Fury, Lightning Bolt, and Red Elemental Blast to control the game. The deck aims to assemble its combo quickly and efficiently, while using cards like Urza's Saga and Ancient Tomb to generate mana to fuel its strategy.

The deck revolves around utilizing Painter's Servant to name a color and then comboing with Grindstone to mill cards from the opponent's library. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provide card advantage and support for the combo. The deck also includes control elements like Force of Will and Metallic Rebuke to protect the combo. Urza's Saga serves as a versatile land that can tutor for key artifacts. The goal is to efficiently assemble the combo while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and card draw.

The deck aims to quickly combo off by using Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to mill the library, with Thassa's Oracle as a win condition. It includes protection spells like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo pieces, alongside interaction like Swords to Plowshares and Spell Pierce. Brainstorm and Ponder help find key pieces, while Urza's Saga provides additional utility. The deck also includes a small amount of disruptive elements like Teferi, Time Raveler and Prismatic Ending to disrupt opponent's plans. It aims to quickly assemble the combo while protecting itself from disruption.

The main idea of this Aggro - Dragon Stompy Legacy deck is to disrupt the opponent's mana base by playing cards like Blood Moon, Magus of the Moon, and Chalice of the Void, while also utilizing fast mana acceleration through cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Lotus Petal. The deck aims to quickly ramp into powerful threats like Karn, the Great Creator and Pyrogoyf, while also having access to removal and burn spells like Fury and Sundering Eruption to control the board and finish off the opponent.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's mana base by playing cards like Magus of the Moon and Blood Moon, making it difficult for them to cast their spells. It also aims to apply pressure through aggressive creatures like Pyrogoyf and Broadside Bombardiers. The deck includes powerful burn spells like Fury and Sundering Eruption to close out the game quickly. The goal is to utilize mana acceleration from cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Chrome Mox to quickly establish a board presence and overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize.

This deck focuses on quick, aggressive plays using Eldrazi creatures to disrupt the opponent's plans and quickly take control of the game. By utilizing cards like Thought-Knot Seer, Sowing Mycospawn, and Glaring Fleshraker, the deck aims to apply pressure early on and maintain that control throughout the game. With a combination of mana ramp and disruptive elements like Chalice of the Void and Kozilek's Command, the deck seeks to overwhelm opponents and secure victory through efficient and powerful Eldrazi creatures.

The key focus of the deck is to control the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage, using powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The deck includes a mix of permission spells like Force of Will and Counterspell, along with efficient removal like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending. It also aims to disrupt opponent's mana base with cards like Back to Basics and Lórien Revealed, while generating card advantage through cantrips like Ponder and Brainstorm. The inclusion of Snapcaster Mage allows for additional value by reusing spells from the graveyard.

This deck focuses on utilizing creatures with activated abilities like Nadu, Winged Wisdom and Nomads en-Kor to generate mana and card advantage. By utilizing cards like Chord of Calling and Green Sun's Zenith, the deck can tutor for key pieces such as Allosaurus Shepherd and Craterhoof Behemoth to quickly close out the game. The deck also includes protection against disruption with cards like Collector Ouphe and Sylvan Safekeeper. With efficient mana ramp and powerful finishers, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a explosive combo finish.

The deck aims to quickly ramp into playing powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier by using cards like Show and Tell and Omniscience. It also includes control elements like Force of Will and Veil of Summer to protect the combo pieces. Cunning Wish adds versatility by allowing access to sideboard cards, while Brainstorm and Ponder provide card selection. The deck seeks to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and spells before they have a chance to react.

The main concept of this deck is to cheat out powerful creatures, such as Emrakul, the Aeons Torn, Archon of Cruelty, and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, using cards like Show and Tell, Sneak Attack, and Stock Up. These creatures have a massive impact on the game once they enter the battlefield, allowing the player to quickly overwhelm their opponent. The deck also includes various counterspells and card draw spells to protect its combo pieces and find the necessary cards to execute its game plan efficiently.
